headline_item.title_zh: 杨立昆离职Meta并创立AMI Labs，力推JEPA模型
headline_item.title_en: Three studies from Meta and AMI Labs back Yann LeCun's bet on JEPA world models over large language models
headline_item.author: Maximilian Schreiner
headline_item.event_summary_zh: AI科学家杨立昆离开Meta后创办AMI Labs，筹集超10亿美元资金，致力于开发具备因果推断能力的JEPA物理世界模型
headline_item.event_summary_en: AI scientist Yann LeCun left Meta in late 2025 to co-found AMI Labs. The company is advancing the Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) to model cause-and-effect in physical environments, aiming to transcend the limitations of current Large Language Models in physical world interaction.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】杨立昆（前Meta首席人工智能科学家，AMI Labs联合创始人）在Meta及AMI Labs：离职并创立AMI Labs，筹资超10亿美元，聚焦JEPA物理世界建模架构
【起因与机理】认为大语言模型难以实现人类水平的通用智能，需从物理交互视角重构机器智能路线
【关键数据与实测】融资规模超10亿美元，核心技术路线确认为JEPA（联合嵌入预测架构）。
【各方立场与态度】技术重心从语言处理转向机器人、工业控制及可穿戴设备的因果推理与行动规划。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Yann LeCun (Former Chief AI Scientist at Meta, Co-founder of AMI Labs) (Meta and AMI Labs): Departed Meta to co-found AMI Labs, raising $1B+ to focus on JEPA physical world architecture
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Believes LLMs are insufficient for human-level intelligence; advocates for physical world causal reasoning
[Key Metrics] Secured over $1 billion in funding to advance JEPA architecture.
[Key Position & Outlook] Shift in technical focus from language processing to physical-world causal reasoning and planning.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 杨立昆从通用大模型向物理交互世界的范式转移，标志着产业界对LLM上限的审视已从概率生成转向因果推理，预示着具身智能领域在技术架构上的新一轮分化。AMI Labs的出现实质上是针对当前算力军备竞赛下、缺乏物理认知能力的AI基础设施所发起的替代性技术路径博弈。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: LeCun’s pivot from LLMs to physical world models signals a critical industry re-evaluation of AI scaling, shifting from probabilistic generation to causal reasoning. This strategic move highlights an emerging architectural split, positioning AMI Labs to challenge existing AI infrastructure that lacks fundamental grounding in physical dynamics.

headlines.title_zh: SAP遭遇网络攻击，源代码遭非法修改
headlines.title_en: SAP confirms a cybersecurity incident; report: hackers obtained its staffers' authentication tokens, letting them copy and alter source code stored on GitHub (Eduard Kovacs/SecurityWeek)
headlines.author: SecurityWeek
headlines.event_summary_zh: SAP确认发生网络安全事件，攻击者通过窃取员工身份验证令牌，成功访问并篡改了存储在GitHub上的源代码
headlines.event_summary_en: Enterprise software giant SAP confirmed a security breach where attackers obtained employee authentication tokens to gain unauthorized access to company GitHub repositories, allowing them to copy and alter source code. This incident exposes critical vulnerabilities within the software development supply chain's identity management.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】SAP SE（企业软件巨头）在GitHub代码托管平台：员工身份令牌被窃，导致核心源代码被非法访问与篡改
【起因与机理】身份验证机制遭受攻击，导致研发侧供应链安全失控
【关键技术规格】攻击者通过窃取身份认证令牌绕过安全壁垒。
【各方立场与态度】软件供应链安全治理面临研发内网准入挑战。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] SAP SE (GitHub repositories): Staff authentication tokens compromised, leading to source code access and modification
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Security breach in identity authentication protocols within the development pipeline
[Regulatory & Investigation Focus] Attackers bypassed security via stolen authentication tokens.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] Supply chain integrity faces critical access control challenges.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 此次事件凸显了DevOps研发环境中身份凭证管理与代码完整性保护的极高风险，尤其是对于SAP此类核心商业系统而言。通过凭证窃取进行的代码篡改，可能引发深层的供应链投毒隐患，软件厂商需加速转向基于硬件加密与零信任架构的研发内网准入控制。
headlines.industry_impact_en: This breach highlights severe risks in DevSecOps identity management and code integrity, particularly for core business software providers. Code tampering via token theft necessitates an urgent industry-wide transition toward hardware-based authentication and zero-trust development environments to mitigate supply chain poisoning risks.

headlines.title_zh: 美国空军Cloud One云平台遭黑客入侵
headlines.title_en: Hackers breached the US Air Force's flagship Cloud One platform, report says
headlines.author: Maximilian Schreiner
headlines.event_summary_zh: 美空军核心云平台Cloud One遭黑客入侵，关键敏感数据恐泄露，美军已暂停系统迁移并启动全面损害评估
headlines.event_summary_en: The US Air Force's Cloud One platform has been breached by hackers who exploited a software vulnerability to infiltrate the control plane, potentially exposing sensitive air defense and logistics data. The Air Force has responded by blocking updates, revoking admin privileges, and engaging US Cyber Command to assess the breach impact.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】美国空军（USAF）、美国网络司令部在Cloud One云基础设施平台：利用漏洞攻入控制层，敏感数据面临泄露风险
【起因与机理】系统日常升级期间被发现存在安全漏洞
【核心事实细节】入侵对象为美空军核心数据平台Cloud One，涉及防空与后勤关键系统。
【涉及范围与推进】美军已执行系统止损措施，网络司令部介入调查，安全审查等级提升。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] US Air Force, US Cyber Command (Cloud One cloud infrastructure): Breached control plane, potential exposure of sensitive tactical data
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Exploitation of software vulnerability during routine upgrades
[Key Fact Detail] Target: USAF's Cloud One platform hosting critical air defense/logistics systems.
[Official Stance & Demand] Response: Immediate lockdown of migrations and updates, ongoing damage assessment by Cyber Command.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 此次事件揭示了单一平台架构在跨云基础设施（集纳微软、亚马逊等）时的安全脆弱性，AI辅助攻击已将传统的补丁修复周期压缩至危险区间。国防供应链的云化程度与黑客探测能力的失衡，将迫使美国防部重构其零信任安全架构，特别是针对AI驱动的自动化漏洞扫描进行防御升级。
headlines.industry_impact_en: The breach highlights the systemic fragility of centralized cloud infrastructures aggregating multiple providers when faced with AI-accelerated vulnerability scanning. This event will likely force a fundamental architectural shift in US defense security protocols toward more robust, AI-resistant zero-trust models.
